_doc: Hero line (spec #296, H2 #298). The first class line added after the #282 slice: a class spec adds jobs/<line>.json, skills/<line>.json (and upgrades/, equipment_drops/ ... only when it has entries) and asset_manifest.d/<line>.json, then appends <line> to DataRepo.LINES (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Skill keys stay inert until their skills are defined in skills/hero.json (an undefined key is never offered). H10 enables Hero alongside F/P; JobTree.default_job() stays 212 (survivor/jobs.json default_job).

112._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #296 D1: Rush (1121006) is Hero's manual mobility skill on the skill key, outside both slot tracks; defined by H6.
112._skill_pool: tier C: spec #296: the seven hand-picked Hero actives (Rush is the mobility skill, not a pool entry).
112._weapon_families: tier C: spec #296: one- and two-handed swords and axes (WeaponInfo.family); armour and shields drop by the Warrior class bit.
112._creation_weapon: tier C: spec #296: the plain Sword (reqJob 0); wearing it needs no class.
112._meter: tier C: spec #296 Combo orbs. Data only until the meter ticket (H3) reads it; tier A source: Combo Attack's description (max 5), Advanced Combo (up to 10).
112._provenance: tier C: spec #296 H10 #306: Hero is playable alongside F/P; 212 remains the default.
